title: Resolution urging Congress to pass the Communities Before Tourism Act
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass and the president to sign the Communities Before Tourism Act, which would require the Federal Aviation Administration and National Park Service to consult with communities under helicopter tour routes before making voluntary agreements with operators. It cites a 2,300% increase in helicopter noise complaints to 311 over five years, including 20,553 complaints in 2025, and health and pollution concerns linked to frequent flights.
